{
  "origin": "United Kingdom",
  "product": "printed books",
  "hts_code": "4901.99.00",
  "unverified": [
    "Section 232 Pharmaceuticals — a Section 232 investigation on pharmaceuticals and pharmaceutical ingredients is contemplated under EO 14309 of June 16, 2025 (U.S.-UK Economic Prosperity Deal Sec. 1); whether a tariff proclamation with a rate has been issued for pharmaceutical products as of 2026-08-05 could not be verified from an official instrument in the corpus. Attempted: /pages/whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions-2025-06-implementing-the-general-terms--ea3364a4.md (referenced but no rate set); no source page confirmed a finished Section 232 pharmaceuticals tariff instrument with a rate covering HTS chapter 30 (the closest chapter; not 4901)."
  ],
  "destination": "United States",
  "last_changed": "2025-11-20 — EO 14358 modified Annex II of EO 14257 to remove additional agricultural products from reciprocal scope (no change to 10% baseline for non-agricultural UK goods such as printed books).",
  "data_as_of_date": "2026-08-05",
  "confirmed_absent": [
    "Section 232 Steel (Proclamation 9705 of March 8, 2018 as amended; Proclamation 10896 of February 10, 2025; UK 25% rate per EO 14309) — out of scope: HTS 4901.99.00 is not a steel article or derivative under Chapters 72/73.",
    "Section 232 Aluminum (Proclamation 9704 of March 8, 2018 as amended; Proclamation 10895 of February 10, 2025; UK 25% rate per EO 14309) — out of scope: HTS 4901.99.00 is not an aluminum article or derivative under Chapter 76.",
    "Section 232 Autos and Auto Parts (Proclamation 10908 of March 26, 2025; UK within 100,000-vehicle quota at 10% total per EO 14309; 10% UK auto parts total effective June 30, 2025) — out of scope: HTS 4901.99.00 is not classified under HTS heading 8703 or 8708.",
    "Section 232 Medium and Heavy-Duty Vehicles (Proclamation 10908 as amended; 25% Section 232 on MHDVs/parts, 10% on buses, effective November 1, 2025) — out of scope: HTS 4901.99.00 is not a medium or heavy-duty vehicle or part.",
    "Section 232 Copper (Proclamation 10962 of July 30, 2025; 50% on semi-finished copper products and intensive copper derivatives effective August 1, 2025) — out of scope: HTS 4901.99.00 is not a copper article or copper-intensive derivative.",
    "Section 232 Timber/Lumber and Derived Articles — UK 10% on upholstered wooden furniture, kitchen cabinets and vanities per EO 14309 of June 16, 2025 effective October 14, 2025 — out of scope: HTS 4901.99.00 (printed books) is not timber, lumber, upholstered wooden furniture, a kitchen cabinet, or a vanity.",
    "Section 232 Semiconductors (25% on certain semiconductors and derivatives effective January 15, 2026) — out of scope: HTS 4901.99.00 is not a semiconductor article or derivative.",
    "Section 301 China Tariff Actions (Lists 1, 2, 3, 4A; active USTR investigation; product exclusions extended through November 10, 2026 by 90 FR 50947) — out of scope: HTS 4901.99.00 is a UK-origin printed book; Section 301 tariffs apply only to People's Republic of China-origin goods.",
    "IEEPA Fentanyl Tariff (EO 14195 of February 1, 2025; raised to 20% by EO 14228 of March 3, 2025; reduced to 10% effective November 10, 2025 by EO 14357 of November 4, 2025) — out of scope: applies only to People's Republic of China-origin articles; UK is not PRC.",
    "Reciprocal Tariff country-specific rate (Annex I of EO 14257 as amended by EO 14326 of July 31, 2025 and EO 14346 of September 5, 2025) — confirmed not to apply: United Kingdom is not enumerated in the 95-country Annex I list (only EU, Japan, South Korea, Switzerland, Liechtenstein among close partners received negotiated replacement rates); UK falls under the 10% rest-of-countries baseline per Sec. 2(d) of EO 14326.",
    "United Kingdom Civil Aircraft Exemption from IEEPA Reciprocal duties (per CBP overview as of October 14, 2025 and EO 14309 Sec. 3 Aerospace) — out of scope: HTS 4901.99.00 (printed books) is not a civil aircraft or civil aircraft part under the WTO Agreement on Trade in Civil Aircraft."
  ],
  "additional_duties": [
    {
      "ends": null,
      "rate": "10%",
      "in_force": true,
      "authority": "Executive Order 14257 of April 2, 2025 (Regulating Imports With a Reciprocal Tariff To Rectify Trade Practices That Contribute to Large and Persistent Annual United States Goods Trade Deficits), as amended by Executive Order 14326 of July 31, 2025; Executive Order 14346 of September 5, 2025; and Executive Order 14358 of November 20, 2025",
      "source_url": "https://federalregister.gov/documents/2025/04/07/2025-06063/regulating-imports-with-a-reciprocal-tariff-to-rectify-trade-practices-that-contribute-to-large-and",
      "effective_date": "2025-04-05"
    }
  ],
  "origin_rules_notes": "United Kingdom is not enumerated in Annex I of EO 14257 (or its successors EO 14326 and EO 14346). UK-origin goods fall under the universal rest-of-countries 10% IEEPA reciprocal rate. UK has no separate \"replacement\" rate agreement like the EU, Japan, South Korea, Switzerland, Liechtenstein; no Section 301 actions apply (China-only); no IEEPA fentanyl actions apply (China-only). Section 232 special UK rates (steel 25%, aluminum 25%, autos 10% within 100k quota, MHDV 10%, auto parts 10% total, upholstered wooden furniture 10%) cover specific steel/aluminum/auto/copper/timber/semiconductor chapters and do NOT extend to printed books (HTS 4901.99.00).",
  "exclusions_in_force": []
}
